hero.tagline: A Tourism Company That Focuses On Social Impact, MSME & Renewable Energy
hero.deskripsi: Nimo Land Group manages a nationwide network of tourist destinations & resorts — from tea plantations in Bandung to the world's largest volcanic lake, Indonesia's tallest ferris wheel, and ecomarine in Bali. One platform, across Indonesia.

tentang.paragraf1: Nimo Land Group manages an integrated network of tourist destinations and resorts across Indonesia. Its network stretches from the tea plantations of Pangalengan Highlands in Bandung to Lake Toba in North Sumatra — the world's largest volcanic lake. While national in scale, each destination and resort is developed around its own local natural and cultural character.
tentang.paragraf2: Moreover, Nimo Group also presents resorts in the Pangalengan and Subang areas, offering extraordinary natural scenery and exceptional comfort that delivers panoramic views and a premium stay experience. With an integrated network of resorts that keeps growing, we ensure every visit is effortless, safe, and unforgettable.
